title: fix(cli, service-settings, console): the official image refuses to start without its database and secrets; administrators see what a production server keeps on its own disk
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DUcNL9fhimxNPTrujEyeSTy)_

Fixes #30120

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: owed as a follow-up, not edited here — `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` (the Docker/Kubernetes row and "Common ops pitfalls") does not say the official image now refuses to start without `OS_DATABASE_URL`, `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and `OS_SECRET_KEY`; every `docker run` example under `content/docs/**` already sets all three, and `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` + `docker/README.md` are updated here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：官方容器镜像在没有显式设置数据库地址、登录密钥、数据加密密钥这三项时拒绝启动，点名缺哪几项，并写明已经在用自动生成值的部署怎样先把原值从旧容器里取出来；其他方式的 `os start` 照常启动，只是在生产模式下把「放在本机磁盘上的东西」打印在启动日志里；管理员在控制台首页和「设置 › 系统概览」顶部看到一条常驻提示（可一键复制要设的变量，可隐藏，隐藏写进审计日志），普通成员看不到。
- 为什么改：#30120（裁决 A3）。镜像文档说这三项必须注入，但代码从不检查：容器里的业务数据是一个 SQLite 文件，登录密钥和加密密钥也在容器磁盘上自动生成，换一次容器就全部丢失，而管理员平时只看控制台、不看日志。
- 风险与回滚：已经在用镜像且没设这三项的部署，升级后会启动失败——拒绝信息逐项写明原值在旧容器的哪个文件里（真实容器里验证过取出原值后能照常启动、不会重新生成密钥），也可设 `OS_DEPLOYMENT_DURABILITY_CHECK_ENABLED=false` 暂时回到旧行为；提示内容只经设置服务的管理员入口给出，公共配置里没有。另外，控制台首屏英文包本 head 实测 60,540 / 60,000 gz（提示文案 +633 字节），要等 #30640 把应用市场文案移出首屏后再合并 main 才会转绿，上限不抬。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/start.ts` 的拒启分支（`durabilityCheck === 'on'`）和写给服务进程的 `OS_INTERNAL_DEPLOYMENT_FINDINGS`；`packages/services/service-settings/src/deployment-notice.ts` 的 `hide`（指纹比对后才写审计行）；`settings-routes.ts` 两条新路由的能力校验 `refuseNoticeCaller`。
- 两分钟验证：先 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`，再在空目录里运行 `OS_DEPLOYMENT_DURABILITY_CHECK_ENABLED=true HOME=$(mktemp -d) node <repo>/packages/cli/bin/run.js start`，预期退出码 1，提示「OS_DATABASE_URL, OS_AUTH_SECRET and OS_SECRET_KEY are not set」并列出从旧容器取值的三个文件。
- 需要你做的：#30714（受管的工作流一行改动）需要 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准，并先于本 PR 合入。

## What changes

**The official image refuses a start it would lose (`packages/cli`, `docker/Dockerfile`).**

- `docker/Dockerfile` sets `OS_DEPLOYMENT_DURABILITY_CHECK_ENABLED=true` in its `ENV`. `NODE_ENV` cannot be the signal: `os start` sets `production` itself on every boot, including the zero-config laptop trial (measured, see Verification).
- With the switch on, `os start` exits 1 before it opens a database or writes a secret, unless `OS_DATABASE_URL`, `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and `OS_SECRET_KEY` are all set explicitly. It names exactly the missing ones and says how to set each. An explicit `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:/path/on/a/volume/app.db` passes, so SQLite on a kept volume stays a choice.
- The refusal also says how a deployment that already ran on generated values carries them over: `docker exec <container> cat <file>` for `auth-secret`, `dev-crypto-key` and `data/objectstack.db` under the home directory, marking which of those files this container holds.
- A switch value other than `true`/`false`/`1`/`0` (or empty) is refused, not read as off.

**Every other `os start` keeps booting, and says what it keeps on its own disk.**

- In production mode, when the database is the defaulted SQLite file, or the sign-in secret or the data key was generated on this disk, the boot prints one block naming each file and the variable that moves it, and says administrators see the same in the Console.
- The same facts go to the server process on an internal, CLI-owned environment channel (`OS_INTERNAL_DEPLOYMENT_FINDINGS`, JSON). `service-settings` spells the name in its own module: no package entry gains an export.

**The administrator's notice (`packages/services/service-settings`).**

- `GET /api/settings/deployment/notice` and `POST /api/settings/deployment/notice/hide`, mounted through the settings family door (`mountFamilyRoute`: held-session gate, anonymous floor `401`, authz outage `503`), for callers holding `manage_platform_settings`. A member gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` and the door never reads the process. Both rows are in `settings-route-ledger.ts`.
- The state: `production`, the findings (`database_local_file`, `auth_secret_generated`, `data_key_file` at high severity with their variable and file; `file_storage_local` and `email_not_configured` at low severity) and a `fingerprint` (the finding ids). Outside production mode the list is empty. The email line reads `IEmailService.isConfigured()`, the signal #30107 added; storage reads the `storage.adapter` setting.
- The hide names the fingerprint the administrator read. It writes one `config_change` row on `sys_audit_log` through the same single insert site the deployment config audit uses (`config-change-audit.ts`), with `metadata.event = 'deployment_notice.hide'`, the fingerprint and the findings. It is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` when the notice changed since it was read (the answer carries the current state), when there is nothing to hide, and when no audit log is mounted (`details.reason: 'no_audit_log'`): a hide that cannot be audited does not happen.
- The state is not on `/api/v1/auth/config` or `/api/v1/runtime/config` (pinned end to end).

**The Console (`ui/packages/app-shell`, `ui/packages/i18n`).**

- `DeploymentNotice` on the home page (both the empty and the populated layout) and at the top of Setup's System Overview dashboard. It is drawn for a resolved workspace administrator only; a member's browser never sends the request. No dialog.
- "Copy the settings" puts an env-file block on the clipboard: each high finding's variable, with a comment saying what value it takes, and for a generated value, which file to carry the current value over from.
- "Hide" posts the fingerprint; on success the hide is remembered per user in this browser (`localStorage`, keyed by the fingerprint, so a new finding brings the notice back). The home page then draws nothing; System Overview keeps one small line with "Show again". A deployment with no audit log says the notice cannot be hidden.
- 18 keys under `deploymentNotice` in all ten language packs.

**Docs.** `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` gets a "When the three are not set" section (the refusal, the `file:` pass, carrying values over, the boot block, the notice and its hide) and corrects the `OS_AUTH_SECRET` row (`os start` generates it into `auth-secret` under the home directory). `docker/README.md` states the refusal, the carry-over and the switch.

## Why

`docker/README.md` declared the three variables required and nothing enforced it: the unchanged image boots with none of them, keeps the business data in a SQLite file in the container layer and mints both secrets on the container's disk (measured below). Replacing the container loses the data, every sign-in and every saved credential. The ruling (A3, 6634240777) refuses that in the image, keeps every other `os start` booting, and tells the administrator, who reads the Console rather than the log.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/commands/start-deployment-durability.test.ts` (20): the switch's values, which variables count as missing and in what order, `file:` URL parsing, the refusal and boot-block text, the channel write and removal.
- `packages/cli/test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts` (8, real `os start` processes): refusal with none set; with only the database missing (names only `OS_DATABASE_URL`); an invalid switch; an explicit `file:` database plus both secrets boots with no block; the defaulted boot prints the block; the administrator reads the three high findings plus the two low ones; a member (created by the admin) is refused `403` with no server path in the answer; neither public config carries a finding, with a non-vacuity control.
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/deployment-notice.routes.test.ts` (19): findings and their order, the CLI's key-file channel, a malformed channel, low-severity lines, outside production; admin `200`, member `403` for read and hide with no env read and no insert, anonymous `401`, no door `503`; the audit row's shape and system context, `409` with no ledger / no engine / a changed fingerprint / nothing to hide, `400` without a fingerprint, `500` when the insert throws.
- Pins updated for two more routes: `settings-routes.anonymous-floor.pin.test.ts`, `settings-routes.auth-gate.pin.test.ts` (six door members), `settings-routes.authz-outage-relay.test.ts`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/deployment-notice/__tests__/DeploymentNotice.test.tsx` (12): admin draws, member never requests, production-only, copy text, hide paths (hidden, no audit log, changed, failed), the per-fingerprint hide, System Overview's line and "Show again".
- **Ablations** (each restored the forbidden behaviour on disk, watched the pin go red, then restored; full output in `/mnt/project-files/server-lane-seat3/30120/ablations.md`):

<details><summary>A1–A9</summary>

| # | Mutation | Red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | capability check removed from the notice routes | 2 / 19 (member read and hide) |
| A2 | the hide writes no audit row | 2 / 19 |
| A3 | the no-ledger refusal removed | 1 / 19 |
| A4 | the notice speaks outside production | 1 / 19 |
| A5 | the fingerprint check removed | 1 / 19 |
| A6 | the Console's admin gate removed | 1 / 12 |
| A7 | the hide not keyed by fingerprint | 1 / 12 |
| A8 | the image refusal removed (dist rebuilt) | 2 / 8 integration |
| A9 | every production start refuses, switch or not | 4 / 8 integration |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Needs #30714 first.** `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml` runs the image built from the checkout with only `OS_SECRET_KEY` and `OS_AUTH_SECRET`; with the refusal it would go red. The one line (`-e OS_DATABASE_URL="file:/tmp/e2e.db"`) is governed, so it rides #30714 (`Refs #30120`), which lands before this PR.
- **The eager `en` catalogue.** `check:eager-closure` measures `i18n-locale-en` at 60,540 gz on this head against its 60,000 ceiling (over by 540). The notice's 18 keys are +633 gz of that chunk (the built chunk with and without the block: 60,440 / 59,807 by `gzip -9`), and `main` had ~95 bytes left (#30588). The ceiling is not raised here: #30640 moves the marketplace copy into a lazy namespace (its reading 57,003), and this branch merges `main` after it lands. Every other chunk and the aggregate are inside their ceilings (aggregate 2,158.4 KB / 2,431.6 KB).
- **What counts as explicit.** A database from `--database`, `OS_DATABASE_URL` or a datasource the project config declares; an auth secret from `--auth-secret` or `OS_AUTH_SECRET`; their legacy aliases too. `OS_DEV_CRYPTO_KEY` does not count for `OS_SECRET_KEY`: it is the dev key the refusal exists to keep out of a container.
- **The image check runs only where the switch is on.** A custom image built `FROM node` that runs `os start` gets the boot block and the notice, not the refusal.
- **The boot block names the three disk-bound facts only.** Local uploads and no email service are on the admin notice at low severity, and the existing storage warning already prints at boot.
- **The hide is per administrator, per browser,** plus a mandatory audit row; there is no server-side "hidden" setting (a settings namespace would need a hub card and nav copy outside this claim). Another administrator, or the same one in another browser, still sees the notice.
- **An un-enforced settings context is not capability-gated,** the same as every other settings route (`ctx.enforced`).
- **The data key finding reads the local crypto provider's tiers** (the CLI's key-file channel first, then the persisted key file). A deployment that registers a non-local `ICryptoProvider` and also leaves `OS_SECRET_KEY` unset would still be told about the local file.
- **Upgrade note.** The changeset tells an image deployment on defaults to carry `auth-secret`, `dev-crypto-key` and the database file over before upgrading; the refusal says the same at the moment it matters. No BREAKING marker: the published packages' surfaces are unchanged.

## Verification

**Measured on `main` `47c457b2` first** (`/mnt/project-files/server-lane-seat3/30120/measure-main.md`): `os start` with `NODE_ENV=production` and none of the three set boots, writes `auth-secret`, `dev-crypto-key` and `data/objectstack.db` under the home directory, and answers health `200`. The official image built from `docker/Dockerfile` (published CLI 18.3.0) boots the same way with none set: the ruling's premise holds.

**Real container, this branch** (`/mnt/project-files/server-lane-seat3/30120/container-verify.md`). Image `objectstack:30120-branch`: this branch's `docker/Dockerfile` built, then the published CLI replaced by this branch's CLI and its workspace dependencies (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli deploy --prod --legacy`), so `os start` in the container is the code under review.

<details><summary>Container readings</summary>

1. None of the three set: exit 1, naming all three, with the carry-over lines.
2. Explicit `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:/data/app.db` on a mounted volume plus both secrets: health `200` after ~10 s, no block, `app.db` on the volume.
3. Upgrade: the published 18.3.0 image ran on a volume with none set (home holds `auth-secret`, `data/objectstack.db`, `dev-crypto-key`); this branch's image on the same volume refuses and marks all three files "(present in this container)"; with the carried-over values set it boots, prints no block, and the crypto provider mints no new key.
4. Switch `false`, none set: boots and prints the block; the first registrant's `GET /api/settings/deployment/notice` lists the five findings with their files; the hide answers `200`; anonymous `401`; `/api/v1/auth/config` names no finding. The hide's `sys_audit_log` row, read from the container's database: `action: config_change`, `user_id` = `actor` = the administrator, `object_name`/`record_id`/`tenant_id` null, `metadata.event: deployment_notice.hide` with the fingerprint and findings.

Not verified in the container: the Console UI, because the deploy bundle carries no built Console (`ConsoleNotBuilt`); the component tests above cover it.

</details>

**Local commands** (exit codes captured before any pipe):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/commands/start-deployment-durability.test.ts`: 20 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts`: 8 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run`: 70 files, 1227 tests passed (the notice routes and the three updated pins among them).
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/deployment-notice`: 12 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui/apps/console exec vite build` then `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure`: exit 1 on `i18n-locale-en` only (see Acceptance notes).
- The derived gate battery (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, plus `pnpm lint`) and its `--ran` reconciliation: in the os-dev report on #30120.
